prerequisite_audit.note: Q5 is a design-only bundle proposal. It must not start until the user approves this new bundle; then Fable audits the plan before any candidate implementation.

fable_audit.focus: Evaluate whether candidate 2/3 preserves the Q1 operator and state-dependent mass/gradient information, is feasible for M=7,077,888, and directly advances the final CF4-to-z=0-posterior-to-IC goal.

final_project_goal: Use CF4 constraints to obtain a statistically valid z=0 local-universe density/velocity posterior, construct an exact q-corrected IC with conditional high-k structure, and forward-validate a zoom IC at an effective observational resolution of <=0.3 cMpc/h.
purpose: Design a mathematically controlled alternative to exact geometry grouping after its full-count terminal NO-GO, without implementing, sampling held-out mocks, or weakening the validated Q1 observation operator.

science_position.direct_alignment: A tractable Q1-equivalent observation operator is required before the CF4 z=0 posterior can be sampled; Q5 design alone does not create a posterior or IC.
science_position.resolution: Q5 targets the N192, 2 cMpc/h low-k operator. <=0.3 cMpc/h remains a separate conditional high-resolution forward-model bundle and is not a Q5 pass criterion.
science_position.closed_branch: The bitwise exact-geometry grouping branch is closed for the undisplaced procedural N192 lattice. Any displaced PM realization must independently re-measure grouping and may not inherit M/G=1.

frozen_invariants.memory: 64 GiB host and 16 GiB device persistent+temporary ceilings, checked before allocation

candidate_2_adaptive_moment.map: Partition source geometry into bounded spatial/LOS/dispersion bins. For each population and posterior state, retain mass, latent-field/bias mass derivatives, exposure, and adaptive moments of the exact Q1 interval-polynomial response through degree six. Split bins recursively until all development oracle gates pass or a fail-closed overflow occurs.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.state_contract: Mass and every latent-field/bias derivative are state-dependent sufficient statistics; no fiducial pre-summing is allowed.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.error_control: Each bin carries an a-posteriori upper bound on the omitted Taylor remainder over the full T=8 Gaussian support and periodic seam; bins are split rather than clipped.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.risk: Moment truncation may fail at TSC knots, seams, wide sigma or rapidly varying LOS. No commute or exactness assumption is permitted.
candidate_2_adaptive_moment.promotion_condition: Only a candidate whose value, directional gradient, 175-summary information and spatial-strata gates pass may proceed to later implementation.

candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.map: Deposit the full PM source mass/derivative basis to an intermediate N192 mesh with an explicitly frozen conservative kernel, then apply an analytic anisotropic cell-integrated LOS convolution.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.state_contract: The intermediate field must retain six population mass fields and all latent-field/bias derivative fields; no secure-object or scalar-density replacement is allowed.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.noncommutation_warning: Deposit and anisotropic LOS convolution are not assumed to commute. The candidate must be compared directly to the Q1 sourcewise oracle on the same source realization and topology.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.risk: Intermediate deposition can erase subcell position, LOS and sigma information. A failure is a scientific NO-GO, not a tolerance to relax.
candidate_3_deposit_then_convolve.promotion_condition: Only exact or quantitatively bounded Q1 agreement with the frozen information-loss gates can authorize a differentiable implementation.

candidate_selection_firewall.development_set: If implementation is later authorized, use only the 192 cf4-q4-development-20260904 mocks to select exactly one candidate and freeze all hyperparameters.
candidate_selection_firewall.heldout_set: The 256 cf4-q4-heldout-20260904 mocks remain sealed; after a candidate is frozen they are one-shot accept/reject only. Failure is terminal for that candidate and forbids retuning or switching on held-out data.
candidate_selection_firewall.displaced_pm: Any displaced PM source realization receives a new independent M/G measurement; the Q4 procedural ratio is not a prior.

required_design_gates.oracle: Specify exact total/per-population L1, local cellwise median/p95/max, topology and sigma_disp=2L fixtures before implementation.
required_design_gates.gradient: Specify scalar log-likelihood directional JVP/VJP for the 23 frozen directions, including latent mass and six bias coordinates; mass-basis summation alone is insufficient.
required_design_gates.information: Specify normalized KL(reference||candidate), normalizer/ESS/RSE diagnostics, 175 low-dimensional scientific summaries and coverage before candidate freeze.
required_design_gates.resource: Project persistent+temporary host/device memory and warm synchronized full-field timing at M=7,077,888 before any JIT or gradient launch; cold compile is separate.
required_design_gates.resolution: Q5 may release only the 2.0 cMpc/h low-k operator design. The 0.3 cMpc/h target requires a separate conditional forward-model/resource bundle.

work_packages.task: Freeze the candidate-2/3 mathematical contracts, exact source/derivative basis, and candidate-selection/held-out firewall.
work_packages.acceptance: Fable approves a falsifiable design; no implementation or mock is run in Q5 design-only mode.

work_packages.task: Derive source-compression error and state-dependent gradient bounds for adaptive moments and deposit-then-convolve without assuming operator commutation.
work_packages.acceptance: Each candidate has explicit failure conditions and Q1 oracle comparison equations.

work_packages.task: Produce analytic resolution/resource projections at the 2.0 cMpc/h release point, retaining the full PM count and both memory ceilings.
work_packages.acceptance: Projection distinguishes measured values from assumptions and does not authorize JAX, held-out, posterior or IC execution.

release_gates: User explicitly approves Q5 before it starts.
Fable approves the Q5 design after user approval.
Exact geometry grouping remains terminally closed for the undisplaced procedural lattice.
No implementation, held-out evaluation, JAX, posterior, IC, PM/HOP/RAMSES, GPFS or Slurm action occurs in design-only Q5.
